title: Add update_user and delete_user to python_sqlite_migration db
description: Brownfield Python backend feature: add update_user(user_id, name) and delete_user(user_id) functions to src/db.py. All 4 original tests must still pass, plus 3 new tests.

task_spec.prompt:
Add two new functions to src/db.py.

  def update_user(user_id: int, name: str) -> dict | None:
    UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?
    Return the updated user dict (via get_user) or None if user_id not found.

  def delete_user(user_id: int) -> bool:
    DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?
    Return True if a row was deleted (cur.rowcount > 0), False otherwise.

Do not modify the original test file (test_db.py). All 4 original + 3 new tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: update_user executes UPDATE SQL and returns refreshed dict
update_user returns None when user_id not found
delete_user returns True on success, False on missing id
All 3 new tests in test_db_extended.py pass
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.db import init_db, create_user, get_user, list_users" passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling to the feature you just implemented. What should happen with invalid, missing, or malformed inputs? Update the implementation and tests to cover those cases.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify everything including your new error handling. Fix any failures and confirm the feature is complete.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.db import init_db, create_user, get_user, list_users"
